subject.title: fix(agents): preserve runtime tool inheritance tokens

question: After the conflict refresh, should OpenClaw preserve policy-filtered runtime materialization selectors in inherited child allowlists for spawned sessions?
rationale: This affects the child-session tool authorization boundary; automation can verify the code shape but should not decide the permanent policy boundary without owner intent.

options.title: Refresh And Land Filtered Selectors
options.body: Rebase onto current main, keep selector preservation filtered through all effective policy layers, and land after owner review of the merge result.

options.title: Move The Fix To Runtime Materialization
options.body: Replace this branch with an owner-directed fix closer to bundled runtime construction if maintainers prefer not to persist selector tokens in child session state.

options.title: Pause For Broader Tool Policy Work
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the broader toolsAllow or tool-visibility direction to define the permanent boundary first.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land Filtered Selectors
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, keep selector preservation filtered through all effective policy layers, and land after owner review of the merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent declared allowlist policy work is closest to the selector-filtering semantics this PR extends.
